rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing something negligently through carelessness or inattention.

example.english: They filled in the form negligently and left out several details.
example.traditional: 佢哋粗心大意咁填份表格，漏咗幾項資料。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 cou1 sam1 daai6 ji3 gam3 tin4 fan2 biu2 gaak3 lau6 zo2 gei2 hong6 zi1 liu2

rows.note: Use this when the careless action is unintentional or done without taking sufficient care.

example.english: I negligently carried the boiling water and ended up spilling it on the table.
example.traditional: 我唔小心咁拎住杯滾水，結果倒瀉咗落張枱度。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 siu2 sam1 gam3 ling1 zyu6 bui1 gwan2 seoi2 git3 gwo2 dou2 se2 zo2 lok6 zoeng1 ci4 dou6

rows.note: Use this specifically when the negligence comes from not paying attention or concentrating.

example.english: The boy did his homework negligently and even got his own name wrong.
example.traditional: 阿仔唔專心咁做功課，連自己個名都寫錯。
example.jyutping: aa3 zai2 m4 zyun1 sam1 gam3 zou6 gung1 fo3 lin4 zi6 gei2 go3 ming4 dou1 se2 co3
